programs.title: Nightmare Next Door
programs.desc: A series of programs presenting authentic stories of people who disappeared in strange circumstances, and during the investigation it turned out that they were murdered by family members, friends or neighbors they had known for years.Murders committed by people close to the victim occur much more often than is commonly believed.Investigations in such cases are difficult and often lead to shocking conclusions.The program used police photos and recordings, and a number of interviews were held with the victims' families.

programs.title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks 2
programs.desc: Visiting the homes of murderers can give you chills.Conversations with prisoners serving sentences for crimes are a controversial and can be traumatic experience.

programs.title: Hunt For The Missing: Chicago
programs.desc: Investigation Discovery provides true crime documentaries, real-life investigations, and mystery-focused programming.

programs.title: People Magazine Investigates: The Secrets Of The Twelve Tribes Cult
programs.desc: Gene Spriggs founds a movement that soon becomes known as Twelve Tribes.His vision of simple, communal life attracts hippies and lost youth searching for meaning and belonging.

programs.title: Who Killed Jane Doe?
programs.desc: Jane Doe - this is the name used to describe deceased women of unidentified identity in the United States.Two stories can be told about each of the victims so called.One of them reveals the behind-the-scenes of the investigation aimed at identifying Jane Doe and explaining the circumstances of her death.The second one presents the fate of the deceased's relatives who are desperately trying to find the missing woman.When these two seemingly completely different stories are combined, the victim regains her identity and her murderer is punished for the crime he committed.
